hero.description: I build websites, online stores and custom systems for small and mid-sized businesses. You talk to me directly, from the first draft to support after launch.

about.title: Who I am
lines: I'm Felipe, a fullstack developer from the countryside of São Paulo, Brazil.
I also run a business of my own, so I think about cost, timelines and return, not just code.
I enjoy swapping ideas with other developers, designers and business owners. If you have a project, want to partner up or just talk tech, reach out.
about.photo_alt: Felipe on the Patriani rooftop in Campinas

contact.cta_desc: Tell me the idea, even if it's still rough. I reply fast and will tell you honestly whether and how I can help.
contact.whatsapp_message: Hi Felipe! I saw your portfolio and would like to talk about a project.
contact.network_desc: I'm always up for swapping ideas, referring work and building partnerships. Find me on LinkedIn or right here.

dallas_sync.title: Dallas Sync
dallas_sync.description: Complete motel management, in production since September 2026 and sold on subscription to other motels. Front desk, inventory, finance and BI in one system.

captions.offline: The internet drops and the front desk keeps checking guests in, adding orders and taking payments. When it's back, everything syncs on its own, with nothing duplicated.
captions.invoice: Snap the supplier's invoice and AI fills in the entry. Someone checks it, and it becomes an expense and a stock entry at once.
captions.bi: The owner sees when the motel fills up and which suites earn the most, without building a spreadsheet.
captions.tenants: Many motels run on the same system, and one never sees another's data.

tenants.shield: Each motel sees only its own

secret.title: Secret Boutique
secret.description: An online store with Mercado Pago checkout, built entirely around discretion: age check at the door, anonymous reviews and trackable orders that never expose the customer.

dallas_motel.title: Dallas Motel
dallas_motel.description: A business website with a digital menu and a panel where management updates suites, prices and holidays on their own, without calling a developer.

experience.lead: Products I build with a team.

omdfarm.name: OMDfarm
omdfarm.description: Real-time telemetry for agricultural machinery: operational map, field logs, productivity BI and an external API for third-party integration. I wrote the initial project and defined the architecture — Nx, clean architecture on the server, standalone Angular on the front — plus the Terraform infrastructure. Presented at Agrishow.
omdfarm.metrics_source: Figures published on the OMDfarm landing page.
omdfarm.visit_aria: Visit the OMDfarm landing page, opens in a new tab

eco360.name: Gestão Eco 360
eco360.description: Multi-tenant platform for waste collection fleet management: live tracking, onboard video telemetry and route coverage by district. I built the entire infrastructure and deployment layer from scratch and delivered the highest-risk subsystems — cross-tenant asset sharing, row-level isolation and snap-to-road telemetry.

services.description: From a simple website to a full system. You explain your business problem, I handle the technical side.

landing_pages.title: Websites & landing pages
landing_pages.description: A fast, good-looking site that explains what you sell and sends customers straight to your WhatsApp or checkout.
landing_pages.example: the Dallas Motel site, with a digital menu and a pricing panel.

ecommerce.title: Online stores
ecommerce.description: An online store with catalog, cart and payments by Pix or card, so you can sell without relying only on marketplaces.
ecommerce.example: Secret Boutique, a store with Mercado Pago checkout.

systems.title: Management systems
systems.description: Custom software to track inventory, orders, bookings or service, instead of spreadsheets and notebooks.
systems.example: Dallas Sync, motel management in production that keeps working offline.

automation.title: Automation & AI
automation.description: I take repetitive work off your plate and connect your tools: WhatsApp alerts, automatic reports and AI assistants.
automation.example: my AI secretary, written up in detail on the blog.

writing.lead: I write about real problems I've solved. A good way to see how I think before we talk.

credibility.title: I'm also a fullstack developer at OMD do Brasil.
credibility.description: There I designed the architecture of OMDfarm, a farm-machinery telemetry platform showcased at Agrishow. It's the same technology and the same care I bring to every client project.

process.lead: No surprises halfway through: you know what you're getting before we commit.

talk.client: Hi! I need a website for my store.
talk.me: Sure! How do you sell today?

launch.client: Can we swap the cover photo?

talk.title: Talk
talk.description: Tell me what you need, over WhatsApp or a call. No commitment.

draft.title: Draft
draft.description: You see a preview and the quote before deciding anything.

build.title: Build
build.description: I build in stages, and you follow along and adjust on the way.

launch.title: Launch & support
launch.description: I put it live on your domain and stay around for tweaks.

diamante.title: Diamante, Calabria
diamante.text: My great-great-grandfather Vincenzo Leone was born in Diamante, in the south of Italy, in 1867, which is where the surname I carry comes from, along with the family that crossed the ocean to Brazil.

oba.title: Silver at the OBA
oba.text: While still in school, I won the silver medal at the 19th Brazilian Astronomy and Astronautics Olympiad.

etec.title: Technical school at ETEC
etec.text: I started a technical course in Systems Analysis and Development at ETEC during the pandemic and ended up pausing it, but that was my first real contact with programming.

ifsp.title: Engineering at IFSP
ifsp.text: After high school I went on to study mechanical engineering at IFSP, and it was the programming classes in that course that brought me back to technology.

dallas.title: Dallas Motel
dallas.text: I built the website and the digital menu for Dallas Motel, and from there the management system that became Dallas Sync, which other motels now pay for as a subscription.

omd.title: OMD do Brasil
omd.text: I joined OMD do Brasil after a conversation with the owner of the company, and I currently look after three production platforms that serve 31 companies.

hoje.title: Today
hoje.text: I split my time between OMD, Dallas Sync and projects for businesses that need a website, an online store or a system built around the way they work.
